info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Drops-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Drops API provides a mechanism to retrieve a list of students who have dropped out of their enrolled educational programs. This endpoint serves educational institutions looking to monitor student engagement and improve retention strategies. By accessing the data through this API, administrators can analyze trends in enrollment drops and identify factors influencing student decisions. This API is particularly beneficial for educational planners, advisors, and policy-makers focused on enhancing student support and optimizing program offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch and drop enrollments for students. It can be utilized to access records of enrollments that are eligible for deletion or modification.
